changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 1 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/7173-ai-pending-actions-inbox-i18n.md`

- names `scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs` → `scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs` — edited by this change

  > The ten pack blocks are locale DATA, and locale data lands in the console's eager `framework` chunk, so `scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs` raises that chunk's ceiling from 512,000 to 524,000 gzipped bytes and re-pins its baseline onto a fresh measurement (502,405 to 514,863). Attributed by three console builds: the merge parent reads 510,192, this branch with the ten `aiApprovals` blocks cut reads 510,192 again, and this branch reads 514,863 — so the whole 4,671-byte delta is the pack data and nothing else. Headroom is kept at the line's own convention (9,137 bytes, 0.10x the regression the gate must catch) rather than widened; most of the overage was pre-existing drift, with the merge parent already at 510,192 of the 512,000 allowed.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `5d689c3f6` (merge-base with origin/main): 2 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1708 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2311 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36468851692)

| Main entry chunk (gzip) | 149.8 KB | 350 KB |

| Status | **PASS** | — |

The **eager closure** is every chunk the entry reaches through static imports — what the browser fetches and parses before the app renders. The entry chunk on its own is a small fraction of it.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `bebf75edbfc70aea7f017b4a2227c07e756b3d3d`
Local-runs: none

Inputs read: card objectui#10996, body and all six comments (seat update 5873066109, seat measurement 5873786983, triage grade 5874625537, triage addendum 5874854243, claim 5876204696, `os-dev-report` 5876552679); PR objectui#11018 body, file list and net diff against `origin/main` (merge-base `5d689c3f6` = `origin/main` at review time; 1 commit, 2 files, +195/-115); `scripts/check-eager-closure-budget.mjs` and `scripts/__tests__/check-eager-closure-budget.test.ts` as `origin/main` carries them; the header of `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` on `origin/main`; the head's check-runs and the PR's two bot comments. Git object reads only (diff, show, rev-list, cat-file); nothing built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

**The pair, field by field. Every move is right.**

- `BASELINE.gzipBytes` 3_133_419 to **3_179_055**: the dev's `vite build` reading of `5d689c3f6` (`eagerGzipBytes`, as the field's own doc defines it). Consistent with CI: the head's Console Performance Budget comment 5876520311 reads 3104.5 KB over 330 chunks, and 3,179,055 / 1024 = 3104.55. Consistent with the seat's card measurement 5873786983 (`4b742f4` = 3,178,471), which the dev's instrument reproduced to the byte as its calibration.
- `chunks` 329 to **330**, `totalChunks` 2309 to **2446**: the report's "330 of 2446 eager"; CI's 330 agrees.
- `commit` `bbf6b02d9` to **`5d689c3f6`**: `origin/main` at measurement, at push, and still at this review (the merge-base is main's tip). `git cat-file -t` resolves it as a commit. It is the tree the reading was taken on: the diff touches no bundler input, so the branch's build input is that tree byte for byte, which is the field's stated meaning.
- `squashMerge` `67485872ed` to **`null`**: exactly what main's own docblock on the field directs ("Write `null` and let a follow-up name the merge once it exists"). The ledger case in the test was re-pinned exact and positional (`[BASELINE.commit]` plus `toBeNull()`), not widened, which is what both docblocks require.
- `MAX_EAGER_CLOSURE_GZIP_BYTES` 3_179_000 to **3_225_000**: `REGRESSION_THIS_GATE_MUST_CATCH_BYTES` = 89 * 1024 = 91,136, unchanged; half = 45,568; 3,179,055 + 45,568 = 3,224,623; nearest thousand = 3,225,000. Every prior entry rounds the same way (recomputed: #5924 3,345,466 to 3,345,000; #6683 3,299,572 to 3,300,000; #6776 3,267,882 to 3,268,000; #7479 3,210,385 to 3,210,000; #9251 3,178,987 to 3,179,000). Headroom 3,225,000 - 3,179,055 = **45,945 = 0.504x**, the header's designed H = REGRESSION / 2. Right.
- **Nothing else moved.** The diff's only non-comment lines are the five `BASELINE` fields and the `MAX` literal. `REGRESSION_THIS_GATE_MUST_CATCH_BYTES`, `PER_CHUNK_GZIP_CEILINGS`, every `PER_CHUNK_BASELINE` value, every exemption list and every import are untouched; nothing under `packages/**` or `apps/**`.

**Prose edits outside the claim's literal wording. Each is forced by a test pin or corrects a stale fact; none changes a value.**

- Header line "Headroom above BASELINE is 45,183 bytes" to 45,945: the header's own bullet says the constants' headroom "is stated once, on MAX_EAGER_CLOSURE_GZIP_BYTES", so this is the one place. 45,183 is #7479's headroom (3,210,000 - 3,164,817), which #9251 never refreshed; the dev's "already stale" is exact.
- `PER_CHUNK_BASELINE` paragraph, "BASELINE's `bbf6b02d9` is dated 2026-09-13" to "BASELINE's `5d689c3f6` is dated 2026-09-28": the test's `holds every "BASELINE carries X" claim` pin matches exactly the shape "BASELINE's `hash`" inside that block, requires such a claim to be present, and holds the hash to the live `BASELINE.commit`. A regex sweep of the main and head files finds exactly one such claim in each, and it is this sentence. Forced. The same paragraph's "ui-components ... shares it too" and the `ui-components` inline comment "the same console build as BASELINE above" become false the moment `BASELINE` moves; both are corrected, and the retired-versus-current comparability is stated correctly. `ui-components: 265_937` and the other three values are unchanged.
- The `BASELINE` block's own prose is rewritten for a reading that is a main commit. It keeps the locator's control phrase "the previous baseline" and names the carried hash, both of which the positive pin requires.

**The new docblock entry, sentence by sentence, against the card and the report.**

- The authorisation 「授权本席位重设基线 (推荐)」 is byte-identical (UTF-8 compared) in the claim 5876204696, the PR body and the docblock. All three attribute it to the maintainer's choice in the `domain:ui` seat 4 session chat on 2026-09-28, which is the claiming session; the option text (re-measure on the latest main, re-pin `BASELINE`, reading plus half the regression threshold, one commit, quote it in the PR) is rendered in the docblock as the claim gives it. The objectui#7122 heading it cites does say "RAISED ONCE".
- Last step `4b742f41d` to `5d689c3f6`, +584, 8 commits: `git rev-list --count` gives 8, `4b742f41d` is an ancestor, 549 + 32 + 3 = 584, and 3,178,471 + 584 = 3,179,055. `plugin-form` +549 from objectui#10986 (`8aa68b159`): the seat's card measurement attributes +549 to `plugin-form` on `8aa68b1` (objectui#10986), and `8aa68b15` is the commit immediately after `4b742f41` in the window. `plugin-view` +32 with `e9ca14ca9` (objectui#10975) as the only `packages/plugin-view` commit in the window: `git log 4b742f41d..5d689c3f6 -- packages/plugin-view` returns exactly that commit, and the entry says "not bisected", which is the honest form.
- Whole window `67485872ed` to `5d689c3f6`, +45,272, 841 commits, fifteen days: `67485872ed` is main's retired `squashMerge` (dated 2026-09-13, the #9399 squash); 2026-09-13 to 2026-09-28 is fifteen days. Both table columns sum to their aggregates (3,133,783 and 3,179,055), the rows account for all 330 chunks, every delta recomputes, and 3,133,783 - 3,133,419 = 364 while 45,272 + 364 = 45,636 = 3,179,055 - 3,133,419. The 76,330 `vendor-icon-*` "lit control" is the figure main's retired `BASELINE` prose recorded for the 277 icon chunks on `bbf6b02d9`. The 841 count is the dev's compare-API figure; this clone is shallow (`rev-list` reaches 114 commits to its boundary), so it stays report-supported rather than independently counted, and nothing read contradicts it.
- "Ceiling alone would carry 91,581, 1.005x": 3,225,000 - 3,133,419 = 91,581, and 91,581 / 91,136 = 1.0049. "The first commit in this position that is an ordinary main commit": main's retired `BASELINE` prose itself says every earlier entry named a branch commit.
- The control-build claims (per-chunk, membership and sensitivity halves passing on `5d689c3f6`; the simulated freshness leg) are the report's `checker_before` and `checker_after`, and CI's Bundle Analysis success on the head matches the after state. No sentence in the entry lacks support in the card or the report.

**Test changes.** The two rendered literals 3060.0 to 3104.5 are `BASELINE.gzipBytes / 1024` to one decimal (3,133,419 gives 3060.0; 3,179,055 gives 3104.5). The history comment's sequence (#6683 3177.7, #6776 3146.8, #7122 3468.0, #7479 3090.6, #9251 3060.0, #10996 3104.5) is consistent with the entries on main.

### ② Semver level

None. `scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs` (header at `origin/main`) guards the `src/` tree of each `fixed`-group package, plus a package's `index.html` and its `files`-listed entries; a root `scripts/` file and its test are in none of those, so no changeset is owed, and the head's Changeset Declaration check concluded success. Nothing published, exported or in any accept set moves, so the claim's `Clause-②: no` holds.

### ③ Boundary flags

**Does the PR do exactly what the option text authorised, and nothing more?** Yes. Re-measured on the latest main (`5d689c3f6`, main's tip at measurement and still at review); `BASELINE` re-pinned to it; ceiling = reading + half the regression; one commit on the branch; the authorisation quoted in the PR body and in the docblock. The triage direction "not the ceiling alone" is honoured: the pair moved together in one commit, and the entry records why the ceiling-alone shape reds the unit test's constant-versus-constant guard (91,581 over 91,136).

**Dev deviations, each answered.**

1. Two `PER_CHUNK_BASELINE` prose sentences: forced by the test pin and by the fact this PR falsifies (see ①); prose only; inside the declared file surface. Answered, not a breach.
2. The unit test moved in three places: all three are invariants main's docblocks name as re-pinned with the pair (the ledger case reds on `null` by design and says so; the two literals are "re-taken each time the baseline moves"). The ledger stays exact. Answered.
3. The header headroom line re-derived: the single stated place; correct arithmetic. Answered.
4. `git fetch --depth=1` of `67485872ed` into the shared `.git`, plus three worktrees, all removed clean: environment hygiene outside the diff, declared. Noted; no action.
5. One pre-push amend to drop a model-named trailer: no pushed history rewritten. Noted.

**Out-of-scope findings.**

- Two pre-existing stale inline comments in `PER_CHUNK_BASELINE` (`vendor-objectstack`: "`34a1578ef`, the same build as BASELINE above"; `i18n-locale-en`: "`755d34a5f` ... the SAME console build as BASELINE above") were false before this PR and are left as they were. They are the objectui#6778 class the test's regex does not reach ("same build as" is not the shape "BASELINE's `hash`"). Correctly kept out of this diff; escalated to the PM as a prose-only follow-up, either folded into the shrink card or filed small.
- `vendor-icon-*` +6,075 over the window as a shrink lead: belongs to the shrink follow-up card triage routes, not to this card.

**Consequence for open PRs, by design, for the PM.** `evaluateCeilingFreshness` (objectui#6245) compares `MAX_EAGER_CLOSURE_GZIP_BYTES` across a PR's base commit, the base tip and its checkout. Once this lands, any open PR whose merge ref was computed before it sees the ceiling moved out from under it and gets exit 2 (a gauge error, not a size failure) until its checks re-run on a fresh merge ref. The claim recorded that none of the six open PRs touches the script. Re-run the parked PRs (objectui#10990 among them) after the merge.
